description: Which muscles the training landed on over a window (default the last 7 days): hard sets per muscle — sets within three reps of failure, or unrated — read against the 10–20 per week most hypertrophy guidance uses, which muscles are still recovering (two or more hard sets in the last 48 hours), and exercises whose sets were not counted because the person never said what they train. For "what have I been training" or "what should I train next". Needs the sets category.

client.description: For a coach: a client id from list_clients, to read that client. Omitted: your own account.

from.description: First day, inclusive. Omitted: six days before `to`.

to.description: Last day, inclusive. Omitted: today in the account time zone.
